description: Progress of encryption batches started with panda_encrypt_videos. With idempotency_key: that batch; without it: every batch not finished yet (including failed videos). Each video: {video_id, status, state, updated_at}; state is pending, in_progress, processed, failed or cancelled. estimated_completion_minutes estimates the whole encryption queue (all accounts), not only your batch, and may be 0 when unknown.
name: panda_get_hls_encryption_batches
title: Get HLS Encryption Batches
